note: Finalists from docs/agent/research_2026-09-26.md compiled into typed specs. status=paper means the loop may trade it on paper; watch means shadow-judge only; rejected means never. Invalidation rules are evaluated in code on every tick against StateVector fields; a rule that persists for persist_ticks flips the setup to invalidated. evidence_class: measured = tested in this repository on real observations; reported = from dated primary/secondary sources; speculation = a mechanism story without measurement.

setups.name: HYPE perp short vs HYPE spot funding carry (perp leg managed here; spot leg held by the operator)
setups.thesis: Longs pay hourly funding to shorts; the interest floor (0.01%/8h) plus HYPE's speculative long demand netted about 7% on capital in 2026 at 25% margin in this repository's own test (docs/finalists.md F1). Not an alpha: it is compensation for supplying leverage.
setups.catalyst: Binance spot listing (2026-09-24) and the Bitnomial CFTC listing (pending) raise speculative demand near the 2026-09-23 all-time high; more long demand means more funding, until arbitrage capital compresses it.
setups.bear_case: The Binance listing makes cross-venue arbitrage easier, which compresses Hyperliquid funding; unlocks add supply; a bear regime turns funding negative for months; the short perp needs USDC margin that the spot leg does not supply, so a fast rally forces top-ups.

invalidation.note: funding negative for 72 consecutive hourly ticks
book drawdown over 5% while running a carry means the hedge is broken

setups.name: Hedged premium reversion on a liquid trade.xyz US-equity perp (H7), external session only
setups.thesis: The hourly premium of xyz perps is an AR(1) with half-life about 1.6 h; honest-timing capture is 9-17 bps over 6 h, which is only positive under growth-mode fees (docs/review_adversarial.md O1). Growth mode for trade.xyz is now reported as enabled (2026-09-26 search snippets), which the 2026-09-24 session could not verify.
setups.catalyst: Growth-mode fees confirmed for trade.xyz (reported); the forward paper test in docs/forward_plan.md can start.
setups.bear_case: A 3x deployer fee increase has been proposed (undated) and would kill the trade; half-spreads in liquid names are unobserved; the backtest measured an hourly average, not the touch; 71% of historical events were internal-session oracle artefacts.

invalidation.note: observed half-spread far above the 5 bps break-even

sources: Coin Metrics substack (trade.xyz in growth mode; search snippet 2026-09-26)
AMBCrypto / Bitget News (3x HIP-3 fee proposal; search snippet 2026-09-26)

setups.name: BTC native perp, regime-conditioned entries chosen by the judge
setups.thesis: Generic directional trading of the most liquid market with the typed judge; the only claim is that a calibrated judge with a strict gate loses slowly enough to be measured. No edge is asserted.
setups.catalyst: None. Regime as of 2026-09-26: multi-week uptrend (+36% since 2026-08-18) driven by ETF inflows and short covering, into a hawkish Fed and 5.2% 10-year yields; short-term consolidation after a 7-9% open-interest flush on 2026-09-25.
setups.bear_case: Post-squeeze rallies reverse; the Fed is hiking; dominance is slipping (58.5%) so BTC may lag alts; a calibrated judge on 1-minute candles faces 9+ bps round trips against sub-bp edges.

invalidation.note: stop directional trading after a 5% book drawdown

setups.name: ENA single-tranche investor unlock on 2026-10-05: pre-event underperformance
setups.thesis: The Ethena Foundation accelerated the remaining original-investor ENA unlocks into a single tranche beginning 2026-10-05 (SEC filings by StableCoinX, 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-17). Investors who waited two years for liquidity tend to sell; supply hits in one day.
setups.bear_case: Widely disclosed, so likely priced; shorts pay funding if the perp funding turns negative; the foundation or treasury companies (StableCoinX) may absorb supply; a squeeze into the date is common.

invalidation.note: paying more than ~9%/yr to be short for a day
already down 15% into the event: priced

setups.name: UNI: sell-the-news into the CME futures listing on 2026-10-19
setups.thesis: UNI more than doubled in a month on an SEC exemption and the CME listing announcement, then fell 11.5% in a day on 2026-09-23. Listing events on this cycle (HYPE on Binance, -4.5% on listing day) have been sold.
setups.bear_case: A CME listing enables basis trades and institutional access, which can add demand; momentum in a name up 67% YTD can run further; two anecdotes are not a base rate.

setups.name: ETH outperforms BTC while the staking queue, treasury buying and ETF flows persist
setups.thesis: ETH is +71% over three months vs BTC +40%; 1.68M ETH queued to stake vs 154k exiting (2026-09-24); BitMine holds 4.9% of supply; ETH ETF inflows have outpaced BTC's on a market-cap-adjusted basis since July (21Shares, 2026-09-01).
setups.catalyst: Glamsterdam upgrade on the Sepolia testnet 2026-10-06; continued ETF inflows.
setups.bear_case: Staking moves coins already owned (supply relief, not demand); ETH is still -10% YTD; one week in September saw $140M of ETF outflows; a hiking Fed hits high beta first.

invalidation.note: below the 2026-09-02 low for a day

setups.name: HYPE perp vs Binance spot dislocations after the 2026-09-24 listing
setups.thesis: A new major venue for the same asset creates transient cross-venue dislocations while market makers connect. The analogous H1 test on commodity perps found about 1 bp of reversion, below any fee.
setups.bear_case: H1 rejected on economics; needs a cross-venue tape that this repository does not have for HYPE.

setups.name: Short ZEC after the privacy-coin momentum breaks
setups.thesis: ZEC is up about 2,500% YTD with record $2.4B open interest; altcoin OI exceeded BTC OI on 2026-09-06 for the first time since 2024, driven by ZEC. Crowded leveraged longs unwind violently.
setups.bear_case: Shorting a parabolic asset has unbounded loss; the timing signal is unspecified; funding may be positive (pays shorts) but a 20% daily squeeze dwarfs it. Rejected: the risk layer cannot make this safe.

setups.name: SUI unlock 2026-10-01
setups.thesis: Scheduled unlock of about 13.26M SUI on 2026-10-01.
setups.bear_case: At about $0.80 that is roughly $10.6M against a $3.3B market cap (0.3%): too small to move price net of costs. Rejected on size.
